# Labs for this section

Training labs belong to a live course edition — numbered classroom work tied to a sprint — the same idea as on [albertprofe.dev](https://albertprofe.dev){.external target="_blank"}.

There is no live AI course on this wiki yet, so there are no Training labs to list. The exact lab numbering for the ML wiki is still open.

When a course exists, this page will point at those labs rather than hiding them only inside a course folder.
